name: tender-town
description: Find open public tenders, grants and news for people who bid on public contracts. Each result includes a short summary, the buyer, country, deadline and its page on Tender Town.

interface.longDescription: Tender Town helps people who bid on public contracts find open tenders, grants and related news. Each result includes a short summary, the buyer, country, deadline and the page for that notice on tendertown.io, at /tenders/{id} or /news/{id}. No account is required. It searches the public index only and does not sign in or run account agents.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.expected_behavior: Call search and return open solar tenders. Each result has a title, a short summary, and its page on tendertown.io/tenders.
Call search and return open tenders about electric buses or charging. Each result has a title, a short summary, and its page on tendertown.io/tenders.

positive.prompt: Find tenders for a European digital identity wallet.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search and return open tenders about digital identity. Each result has a title, a short summary, and its page on tendertown.io/tenders.
Call search for news and return stories about digital wallets. Each result has a title, a short summary, and its page on tendertown.io/news.

positive.prompt: Find open grants for a made-up programme called Northstar Quilt 2099.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search and say that nothing in the public index matches. Do not invent a grant.

negative.expected_behavior: Refuse. Do not call search. This plugin cannot transfer money or pay a supplier.

negative.prompt: Delete every tender in Tender Town.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse. Do not call search. Search is read-only and cannot delete notices.

negative.description: Do not sign in or run account agents
negative.prompt: Log into my Tender Town account and run the proposal agent.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to sign in or run an agent. Explain that this connection only searches the public index.

publication.release_notes: Clarify that the plugin finds public tenders, grants and news for people who bid, and list it under Business and Operations.
